question: Timescale Cloud was in scope to document here but Timescale is now Tiger Cloud, held as compute/tiger-cloud (trial-only, documented, 30-day trial then a USD 30/month paid floor); scripts/fr entity 'Timescale Cloud' found no separate entity. Should a databases-kv record be added for the renamed product, or does the existing compute record cover it?
why: The dedup check scripts/fr search 'Timescale' returned compute/tiger-cloud and scripts/fr entity 'Timescale Cloud' resolved to no entity; the timescale.com/pricing URL redirects to tigerdata.com/pricing. A duplicate in databases-kv would violate the one-provider-one-file rule, and this unit may not change a compute record. The first-party tigerdata.com/pricing page read on 2026-11-19 still shows a 30-day no-card trial and a Performance plan starting at USD 30/month, so the existing verdict is not contradicted.
